name: Defender of the Faith
text: Every model in the bearer's unit has its Save characteristic improved by 1. In your Command phase you may discard one Miracle die; if you do, until the start of your next Command phase models in the bearer's unit have +1 Objective Control.

effect.name: Defender of the Faith
effect.text: The bearer's unit (attached unit included) has its Save improved by 1; discarding a Miracle die in your Command phase adds 1 to the OC of its models until your next Command phase.

name: Righteous Fury
text: The bearer's unit may shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. In your Command phase you may discard one Miracle die; if you do, until the end of that turn charge rolls for the bearer's unit may be re-rolled.

effect.name: Righteous Fury
effect.text: The bearer's unit (attached unit included) can shoot and charge after Advancing or Falling Back; discarding a Miracle die in your Command phase lets it re-roll charge rolls that turn.
